The '''Salvara system''' was located in the [[Tennuutta sector/Legends|Tennuutta sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated between the [[Euceron system/Legends|Euceron system]] of the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]] and the [[Talcene system/Legends|Talcene system]] of the [[Talcene sector/Legends|Talcene sector]]<ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which served as the dividing line between the regions known as the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TEA" /> that were fought from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Salvara [[Star system/Legends|system]] lay in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the Confederacy.<ref name="TEA" /> At one point, the system was the site of<ref name="Gamemaster">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen, Revised]]''</ref> the [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Battle of Salvara]]<ref name="TCW">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref> of the [[Tenuutta Skirmishes]]<ref name="Gamemaster" /> that resulted in a Republic defeat.<ref name="TCW" /> The Confederacy also maintained a deep-space [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] development [[Space station/Legends|station]] near the Salvara system toward the end of the Clone Wars.<ref name="BtR">''[[Beyond the Rim]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Salvara" was originally introduced in reference to a battle first mentioned in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> It was subsequently established as a distinct [[Star/Legends|star]] system in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" />
